Both pieces are now in place. Let me trace the `export KEY = # note` case once more carefully, since it was one of the failing tests:

1. `_multiline_whitespace` → nothing
2. `_export` = `(?:export[^\S\r\n]+)?` → consumes `export `
3. `parse_key` → `KEY`
4. `_whitespace` = `[^\S\r\n]*` → consumes ` `
5. peek `=` → yes
6. `_equal_sign` = `=` → consumes `=`
7. `parse_value`: peek is ` ` → `parse_unquoted_value` → captures ` # note` → `re.sub` → `""` ✅

All four failing cases now resolve to `""`. Let me also verify the `_comment` regex at line 161 doesn't interfere. After `parse_value` consumes the whole rest of line via `_unquoted_value` (`[^\r\n]*`), the reader is at end-of-line, so `_comment` matches empty and `_end_of_line` matches. Good.

One more edge case to confirm — a line that is *only* a comment, e.g. `# comment`:
- `parse_key` sees `#` → returns `None`
- `_whitespace` → nothing
- peek is `#`, not `=` → `value = None`
- `_comment` consumes `# comment` ✅ (ordinary comments preserved)

And `KEY=#literal`:
- `_equal_sign` consumes `=`
- `parse_value` peek is `#` → `parse_unquoted_value` → captures `#literal` → `re.sub(r"\s+#.*", ...)` finds no whitespace before `#` → `#literal` ✅

The fix is complete and minimal — a single-character change to `_equal_sign`. The `parse_unquoted_value` regex was already correct; the bug was solely that `_equal_sign` was greedily consuming the whitespace that the comment-stripping logic depends on.

action.message:
Diagnosis: `_equal_sign` was `=[^\S\r\n]*`, greedily consuming whitespace after `=`. For `KEY= # note`, the value reader then started at `#`, so `parse_unquoted_value`'s `re.sub(r"\s+#.*", "", part)` saw no preceding whitespace and returned `"# note"` instead of `""`.

Change plan (applied): reverted `_equal_sign` to `=` in `src/dotenv/parser.py` (line 24). Now the whitespace after `=` reaches `parse_unquoted_value`, whose existing `\s+#.*` strip yields `""` for `KEY= # note`, `KEY=  # note`, `KEY=\t# note`, and `export KEY = # note`. `KEY=#literal` and `KEY=a#b` keep their `#` (no preceding whitespace). Quoting, exports, and ordinary `# comment` lines are unaffected. Only `src/dotenv/parser.py` was edited; no tests/docs/deps touched.
